This [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] '''male''' was a member of [[Birok's gang]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. He was killed along with the other members of the gang by [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. [[Birok]] tried to capture Tiin so he could give him over to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], but failed and the Jedi killed his would-be captors.
